name: PCHEM
recent: PCHEM 近期公告几乎全部是 EPF Board 的股东权益变动申报，未见重大合约或企业活动。10 月初宣布 CEO 退休，并由 Izwan Ismail 自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起接任董事经理兼 CEO。最新财报显示 2026 年 6 月止季度营收环比增长 12.7%，净利环比增长 3.2%。
notable: CEO 退休，Izwan Ismail 将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日接任董事经理兼 CEO。
EPF Board 在 10 月至 11 月期间连续多日申报股东权益变动。
risks: EPF Board 连续多日申报股东权益变动，显示大股东持股出现变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 79.03 亿，环比增长 12.7%，同比增长 22.8%；净利为 MYR 4.14 亿，环比增长 3.2%；净利率为 5.2%，低于上一季度的 5.7%。

recent_en: PCHEM's recent announcements are almost entirely EPF Board substantial shareholder changes, with no major contracts or corporate exercises. In early October, it announced the CEO's retirement and the appointment of Izwan Ismail as MD and CEO effective 1 January 2027. The latest quarter ended June 2026 showed revenue up 12.7% QoQ and net profit up 3.2% QoQ.
notable_en: CEO retires; Izwan Ismail will take over as MD and CEO effective 1 January 2027.
EPF Board filed substantial shareholder changes on multiple consecutive days from October to November.
risks_en: EPF Board filed substantial shareholder changes on multiple consecutive days, indicating changes in major shareholder holdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 7.903 billion, up 12.7% QoQ and 22.8% YoY; net profit was MYR 414 million, up 3.2% QoQ; net margin was 5.2%, down from 5.7% in the previous quarter.
